q: The Minimum Wages Act, 1948 applies to ___.

options.A: a basic rate plus a special allowance

q: The special allowance under the Act is linked to ___.

To advise on fixation of minimum wages, the Government appoints ___.

options.C: fixation and revision of minimum wages

q: Overtime under the Minimum Wages Act is payable at ___.

options.A: the higher of the two minimum rates

q: Deductions from minimum wages are allowed only as ___.

options.B: basic and allowance combined in one rate

q: The Minimum Wages Act, 1948 extends to ___.

q: Wages under the Act means ___.

options.C: all remuneration capable of being expressed in money
